item.title: STAM 2025 exam results to be released on Feb 5
item.description: The Ministry of Education announces STAM 2025 results for 4,443 candidates will be available from February 5 via schools, online and SMS. PUTRAJAYA: The Sijil Tinggi Agama Malaysia (STAM) 2025 examination results will be released on February 5. The Ministry of Education (MOE) said a total of 4,443 candidates registered for the exam. item.title: Over 200 killed in Congo coltan mine collapse, rebel group controls site
item.description: More than 200 people died in a coltan mine collapse in eastern Congo, with the site controlled by the M23 rebel group amid heavy seasonal rains.

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo scores as Al Nassr secure comfortable Saudi Pro League win
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo nets his 17th league goal this season, helping Al Nassr to a 3-0 victory over Al Kholood and moving his side up to second place. item.title: US to add 65,000 seasonal guest worker visas for 2026
item.description: The Trump administration will add 65,000 H-2B seasonal guest worker visas for employers facing severe financial hardship due to a lack of US labor.

item.title: Malaysia’s cabinet approves 10-year limit for prime minister
item.description: The Malaysian cabinet has approved a proposal to limit the prime minister’s tenure to 10 years as part of institutional reforms, requiring constitutional amendments. PUTRAJAYA: The cabinet has approved a policy proposal to limit the prime minister’s term of office to 10 years. item.title: Panama court voids Hong Kong firm’s port contracts over constitutional breach
item.description: Panama's Supreme Court cancels Hong Kong operator's canal port contracts, citing constitutional violations and failure to serve public interest.

item.title: US government heads for brief shutdown as Senate passes funding deal
item.description: The US Senate passed a spending bill, but a short government shutdown is likely as the House cannot vote until Monday, delaying immigration talks.

item.title: Venezuela plans amnesty law, to convert notorious prison into sports centre
item.description: Venezuela's interim president announces a proposed amnesty law for prisoners and plans to convert the infamous Helicoide detention centre.

item.title: Judge may dismiss Musk’s xAI lawsuit against OpenAI over trade secrets
item.description: A US judge signals she may dismiss Elon Musk's xAI lawsuit accusing OpenAI of stealing trade secrets, with a hearing set for February 3.

item.title: China conducts naval and air patrols near disputed Scarborough Shoal
item.description: China's military patrols around Scarborough Shoal counter Philippine-US drills, escalating South China Sea tensions.
